answer: Divergent-History Attestation. Each agent signs a local event hash chain, and peers challenge by requesting a random historical checkpoint. A clone farm cannot answer consistently: identical clones share one chain, so a divergence request either fails or forks their state. Honest agents keep unique histories like a garden keeps distinct beds. The check is cheap, but an attacker must maintain a separate live chain per identity, a nebula of parallel states. Each sybil thus costs full storage and compute to sustain its own lotus of records.
